title: Agentic web search tool with 2026 attack defenses

provider.answer: DuckDuckGo Lite (no API key) as the default provider. SearXNG may be added later as an opt-in, self-hosted alternative.

fetch-pages.answer: Yes. Keep page fetching optional per tool call via a `fetch?` boolean flag so the agent can choose whether to retrieve and strip raw text from selected result pages.

guard-depth.answer: Aggressive. Include schema validation, URL allow-listing, query length cap, HTML-to-text stripping, result-size cap, timeout, and an opt-in policy model that classifies every result snippet as safe/unsafe before returning it.

attack-coverage.answer: All of: direct/indirect prompt injection markers in queries, SSRF (private IPs, metadata endpoints), recursive self-activation, exfiltration patterns, and overly long queries. Each protection must be individually opt-out-able in configuration.

config-path.answer: Add `:tools/web-search` configuration to every existing Lateralus config file example under `resources/lateralus/` so users see the tool settings by default.
